from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class BME280_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    REG_WIDTH = 8

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.regs = {
            0xD0: 0x60,  # id
            0xE0: 0x00,  # reset
            0xF2: 0x00,  # ctrl_hum
            0xF3: 0x00,  # status
            0xF4: 0x00,  # ctrl_meas
            0xF5: 0x00,  # config
            0xF7: 0x80,  # press_msb
            0xF8: 0x00,  # press_lsb
            0xF9: 0x00,  # press_xlsb
            0xFA: 0x80,  # temp_msb
            0xFB: 0x00,  # temp_lsb
            0xFC: 0x00,  # temp_xlsb
            0xFD: 0x80,  # hum_msb
            0xFE: 0x00   # hum_lsb
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if nbytes == 1:
            return (self.regs[addr] & 0xFF00) >> 8
        else:
            return self.regs[addr]

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr in [0xF2, 0xF4, 0xF5]:  # ctrl_hum, ctrl_meas, config
            self.regs[addr] = data & 0xFF  # only write lower byte
        elif addr in [0xE0]:  # reset
            if data == 0xB6:  # soft reset
                self.regs = {
                    0xD0: 0x60,  # id
                    0xE0: 0x00,  # reset
                    0xF2: 0x00,  # ctrl_hum
                    0xF3: 0x00,  # status
                    0xF4: 0x00,  # ctrl_meas
                    0xF5: 0x00,  # config
                    0xF7: 0x80,  # press_msb
                    0xF8: 0x00,  # press_lsb
                    0xF9: 0x00,  # press_xlsb
                    0xFA: 0x80,  # temp_msb
                    0xFB: 0x00,  # temp_lsb
                    0xFC: 0x00,  # temp_xlsb
                    0xFD: 0x80,  # hum_msb
                    0xFE: 0x00   # hum_lsb
                }
            else:
                self.regs[addr] = data & 0xFF  # ignore other writes
        else:
            self.regs[addr] = data  # ignore writes to RO fields
